brief.title: Mobile salvage extraction roguelite
brief.player_fantasy: Explore compact ruined biomes, fight threats, salvage useful parts, extract safely and restore a persistent workshop.
brief.core_loop: Move and fight, break salvage, collect rewards, choose an upgrade, extract, improve the workshop, then run again.

discovery_effort.notes: Dogfood 001 predates dedicated discovery-effort instrumentation. Coverage and planned work reduction are measurable, but a future comparison run must record search/fetch counts and elapsed discovery time before #116 can justify a continuously operating agent.

capabilities.requirement: Responsive third-person mobile-capable locomotion and camera foundation.
capabilities.rationale: The starter already supplies a working character controller, camera controls and gamepad path; adaptation should remove more generic work than rebuilding those systems independently.
remaining_evidence: execute on chosen stable Godot version
replace/extend desktop input with target touch controls

capabilities.requirement: Breakable/collectible world rewards that feed the run loop.
capabilities.rationale: The starter includes collectibles and reusable scene/gameplay patterns; adapt those into salvage nodes rather than recreate pickup plumbing from scratch.

capabilities.requirement: Enemy state/behavior architecture that can grow beyond the first simple greybox enemy.
capabilities.rationale: LimboAI could remove behavior-tree/state-machine framework work, but unresolved dependency/demo-asset boundaries and framework overhead prevent automatic adoption.
remaining_evidence: compare complexity against native state logic

capabilities.requirement: Inventory/loot data model suitable for run rewards and persistent workshop resources.
capabilities.rationale: Current cleared registry does not yet contain an eligible inventory system; Creator Mode must extend external discovery instead of generating one immediately.
remaining_evidence: multiplayer and persistence fit if required
capabilities.gap_reason: External search found no currently registered and clearance-screened inventory candidate.

capabilities.requirement: Versioned local save and persistent workshop/meta-progression data with recovery behavior.
capabilities.rationale: Official demos may contain useful persistence patterns, but the collection-level asset/dependency clearance is unresolved and no dedicated save candidate is screened yet.
capabilities.gap_reason: No dedicated source-verified save/meta-progression component has passed the external reuse gate.

capabilities.requirement: One-thumb/mobile touch controls, input remapping and platform haptic feedback.
capabilities.rationale: The starter gives controller/gamepad foundations but does not establish the required mobile touch/haptics path; do not pretend desktop input reuse solves mobile feel.
capabilities.gap_reason: Existing screened starter does not cover the mobile-specific interaction requirement.

capabilities.requirement: Commercial-safe low-poly prototype environment and prop art before bespoke style production.
capabilities.rationale: Use a directly sourced CC0 Kenney pack for prototype/world composition before generating generic props; freeze the exact pack/files when selected.

capabilities.requirement: Commercial-safe interaction/combat/UI sound effects for prototype feedback.
capabilities.rationale: Use existing CC0 SFX for the prototype feedback layer before spending generation budget on commodity sounds; later style/audio direction can replace them deliberately.

evidence_boundary: This is a source-verified planning experiment stacked on PR #110. It estimates generic work that may be avoided but claims no realized development-time, quality, performance or production-readiness improvement until the selected reuse plan is executed and measured.
